column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# artifact
# kind: command|hook|agent|skill|mod · phase: understand|shape|decide|plan|build|verify|review|ship|any
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# Contract and gates: scripts/lib/plugin-checks.sh (pc_lanes_*).
# route-prompt offers WHICH tool; the reminder hooks nudge about WHAT to do — different jobs,
# so no shared territory. The yield is not invented here: the charter this hook injects already
# says "clarification outranks tool-fit" (hooks/route-prompt.sh, rule 3), so the row records a
# deference the plugin already ships. That charter is now backed by rank as well as prose —
# taskmaster:remind holds arcRank 25, ahead of every other arc voice — where until 2026-09-14
# it held 90 and lost to all of them. prime.sh (SessionStart), route.sh (PostToolUse) and
# summary.sh (SessionEnd) are outside the gated channel and carry no row this run.
# subagent-skills (SubagentStart) is outside it too and declares a row anyway: it speaks inside
# every plugin subagent, where candor:preamble also speaks, so its territory is written down.
# Phase `any` because a spawn can come at any point of the arc — a reviewer at review, a
# worker at build — and the hook reads no phase sentinel.
skill-router:route-prompt
column5: prompt head passes the work-shaped gate (a making verb, or a symptom token bound by a state verb) AND no catalog marker exists for this session

column1: skill-router:compact-capsule
column5: SessionStart fires with source=compact AND at least one of .claude/cc-phase.json, .claude/task-runner/active-run.json, .claude/task-runner/scope.json, .claude/taskmaster/ledger-*.md exists

column1: skill-router:subagent-skills
column5: a SubagentStart for a plugin-scoped agent whose definition declares bestpractices-skill: and at least one declared skill has evidence in prime.sh's manifest rows at the project root, with its owning plugin installed; silent under CC_REMIND=off or CC_SUBAGENT_SKILLS=off

column1: # lane-cofire-ok: skill-router:compact skill-router:compact-capsule
skill-router:listing
column5: prompt.attachment of the skill_listing on CLI 2.1.291+ with CC_ROUTE_SCOPE (or cc_route_scope, default off) on and prime.sh's evidence readable; drops the listed entries of the eight stack skills whose evidence row does not hold here, naming them on one line the Skill tool still loads from

column1: skill-router:compact
column5: session.compact of the main conversation on CLI 2.1.291+ while .claude/cc-phase.json, .claude/task-runner/active-run.json, its scope lock or a taskmaster ledger is on disk, with CC_COMPACT_STEER (or cc_compact_steer) not off; adds at most 1,200 characters to the summarizer's instructions, before the summary compact-capsule restates after
